lines.en: I beat my tail and swim slowly upstream.

lines.zh: 我的鳞在浑水里泛着银色。
lines.en: My scales glint silver in the murk.
I cruise over the riverbed pebbles.
I swim beneath the tree shadows.
The current pushes; I go with it.
I go round a sunken log.
I swim steadily through the shallows.

lines.zh: 我的身体偏亮，很容易认出。
lines.en: My body is pale; easy to spot.
I swim along the grassy roots of the bank.
I rise a little toward the surface.

lines.zh: 我游动的波纹一圈圈散开。
lines.en: My wake spreads in rings.
I work slowly through this rapid.
I hover, fins barely moving.

lines.zh: 我的颜色比同伴浅一些。
lines.en: My color is paler than my fellows'.

lines.zh: 我在等水面落下来的东西。
lines.en: I wait for what falls from above.

lines.zh: 河底的光斑在我背上移。
lines.en: Dappled light drifts over my back.

lines.zh: 我不慌不忙，慢慢张合嘴。
lines.en: Unhurried, I open and close my mouth.
I can't see far; the water is murky.
Weeds brush lightly across my flank.

lines.zh: 我在这一段河湾待惯了。
lines.en: I'm used to this stretch of the bend.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向水流来的方向。
lines.en: I turn slowly toward the current.
When water stirs, I go to look.
My shadow falls on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我停在石缝边上歇一歇。
lines.en: I stop by a rock crevice to rest.
The river is cold; I settle into it.
I'm slow and easy, but I never hide.
You crouch at the bank, watching the water.
I swim under your shadow.
My face shows very little.
Your hand moves just above the surface.

lines.zh: 我在水里看你，嘴一张一合。
lines.en: I watch you from the water, mouth opening and closing.
There's no blood on you.

lines.zh: 我围着你的倒影游了半圈。
lines.en: I circle half around your reflection.
Your reflection is much larger than me.

lines.zh: 我摆了一下尾，水花很小。
lines.en: I flick my tail; the splash is small.
Are you going to drop something in?
I watch your feet from below.

lines.zh: 你的鞋快踩进我的河湾了。
lines.en: Your boot's about to step into my bend.
I swim a little closer.

lines.zh: 我的鳞在你眼前闪了一下。
lines.en: My scales flashed before your eyes.

lines.zh: 我们隔着水面，谁也不先动。
lines.en: Across the surface, neither of us moves first.
My scales shine like lemon peel.
Everything in this water is smaller than you.
I drift back toward the weeds.

lines.zh: 我的柠檬色鳞片被撞翻了。
lines.en: My lemon-colored scales got knocked over.
A scale came loose in the water.
I dart behind a stone.
A thread of blood in the water.
I beat my tail to flee.
One flash of pain; it's bearable.
I've memorized the shape of your hand.
I've clouded the water.
A flick of my tail and I can still ride the current.
This time I'll keep further off.
That's food, isn't it? Let me look.
I rise, mouth open.
The crumbs spread on the surface.
I eat slowly, bite by bite.
The taste is faint, but fine.
Don't shake it; I can reach.

lines.zh: 这点东西，分给同伴也好。
lines.en: This much could be shared with the others.

lines.zh: 我尝了一口，又游回来要。
lines.en: I taste it once and swim back for more.

lines.zh: 河面上的果子，我用嘴顶。
lines.en: I nudge the fruit along the surface.
Thanks; I'll remember.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，撞到我的背。
lines.en: You stepped into the water and hit my back.

lines.zh: 我这种体型，很容易被踢到。
lines.en: A body my size is easily kicked.
I slide beside your leg.
We stir up a patch of silt.
Don't kick about; there are stones below.
I bump once and swim off.
The surface gave a small sound.
I retreat behind a rock crevice.
The water here is deep, not wide.
You go that way; I'll move aside.

lines.zh: 一条浅色的同伴靠近了。
lines.en: A pale companion draws near.
Our fins almost touch.
We swim side by side in the weeds.

lines.zh: 它身上的斑纹比我的淡。
lines.en: Its markings are fainter than mine.

lines.zh: 卵要藏在石缝里才安全。
lines.en: Eggs are safest hidden in rock crevices.
This bend can feed them.

lines.zh: 我和它并排，绕着同一块石头。
lines.en: Two pale shadows side by side by the stone.
The current brings us level.

lines.zh: 我的鳞和它的颜色很配。
lines.en: My scales suit its color.
We sink slowly beneath the weeds.
I gulp down that crumb.
I nudge the sunken fruit about.
It's too big to swallow.
My scales are a pale lemon.
I take a bite; not bad.
I'm not picky about the riverbed.

lines.zh: 果子含在嘴里，我慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I hold the fruit in my mouth and chew slowly.
This will do me for a day.
I fling it to the surface.
The rest washed away.
That thing can be eaten.
I see it, right there.
I swim toward it slowly.
This isn't a fight; it's a meal.
The sound of it falling in is nice.
I move beneath it.
My share is in this river.

lines.zh: 我尾鳍一摆，朝那点碎屑去。
lines.en: A flick of my tail and I head for that crumb.
Its position is shallow.
One beat of my tail and I speed up.
I'll try one bite.
The others haven't noticed.
It fell right where I wanted.
I open my mouth toward it.
The current pushes it to me.
This suits me well.
I follow the ripples.
It floats on the surface, slowly.
I wait below for it to sink.
The water's clear; I can see it.

lines.zh: 我侧着身子，从石缝里穿过。
lines.en: I turn sideways and slip through the rock gap.
The current pushes it shoreward.

lines.zh: 水纹一推，我就到了它下面。
lines.en: One push of the current and I'm beneath it.
I look up; I'm right below it.

lines.zh: 它的影子在水里很清楚。
lines.en: Its shadow is clear in the water.
Slowly, without startling it.
The water here is shallow; easy.
My mouth is already aimed.
It's about to sink.
I'll wait a little longer.
Right there is the spot.

lines.zh: 我的嘴对准了它落水的地方。
lines.en: My mouth is aimed where it'll hit the water.
It touched the surface.

lines.zh: 水里那一群，都是我的亲戚。
lines.en: That school in the water is my kin.
I bite down on the morsel.
I butt it up with my snout.
I knock it to the surface.
The splash is small.
I gulp; it goes down.
I flick my tail clear of your hand.

lines.zh: 我这一顶，只是想把果子弄碎。
lines.en: This nudge is just to crack the fruit open.
It's stuck in my throat.

lines.zh: 我的鳞是柠檬色的，很亮。
lines.en: My scales are lemon bright.
It breaks into pieces.
I chew slowly, unhurried.

lines.zh: 水面上的碎屑被冲走了。
lines.en: The scraps wash away.
I circle once, content.
This much force is only for feeding.
I lunge with the current and bite.

lines.zh: 我把它顶到浅水的石头上。
lines.en: I shove it onto a shallow stone.
I swim out of the murk.
A flash of silver breaks the surface.
Piraputanga, here.

lines.zh: 我从石头底下摆尾游出来。
lines.en: I flick my tail out from under the stone.
I cruise slowly round the bend.
My scales gleam underwater.
That part of the bed is my usual run.
I drifted down from upstream.
My shadow shows by the weeds.
I'm a big fish for this river.
I rise a little.
Another shadow on the river surface.
One tail beat and I move on.
I know every stone on this bed.
I circle half the bend.
The water rustles softly; I'm near.
My body shows pale in the water.
This water is cool; I like it.
Fire on the surface; I sink deeper.

lines.zh: 我被摔到石头上，又滑回水里。
lines.en: I'm thrown onto stone, then slide back in.

lines.zh: 我的鳃堵住了，喘不上水。
lines.en: My gills are blocked; I can't draw water.
The blast turns the water white.

lines.zh: 鳞片挡不住，箭穿过去了。
lines.en: Scales failed — the arrow went through.

lines.zh: 那道光照进水里，我眼睛发花。
lines.en: Light enters the water and my eyes swim.
Too hungry to swim.

lines.zh: 雷顺着河水流过来，我全身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning runs through the river and I stiffen.
There is no such place in water.
